intro: The Horn of Echeyakee is a hunting instrument provided by Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads. Sounding it among the ancient kodo remains northeast of the settlement calls forth Whitemist, the legendary white predator of the Barrens.

p: Given to initiates testing their prowess in the hunt, the horn's call echoes across the savannah to summon Echeyakee, whose name translates from Taur-ahe as 'Whitemist.' Known as the king of the savannah cats, Echeyakee is revered by tauren hunters as both mercy and death, striking so swiftly that his quarry feels neither terror nor suffering. The horn is meant to be sounded only at the great predator's lair, a sun-bleached nest of giant kodo bones tucked behind the hills northeast of the Crossroads.
